stem: A clogged component can only be reached by disassembling a powered unit. Technician I is authorized only for external cleaning. What should happen?
choices: Escalate to authorized maintenance instead of disassembling the unit
Disassemble it after unplugging, regardless of procedure
Use a tool through the guard
Keep running the equipment until the clog clears
rationale: Operator care does not automatically include servicing or disassembly; authorization and hazardous-energy controls matter.
